product_one_liner.value: RedTeam provides construction management software for commercial general contractors to manage bids, budgets, daily logs, documents and projects from preconstruction through closeout.
product_one_liner.notes: RedTeam directly describes its construction management software, commercial-general-contractor audience and bid-to-closeout workflows. Source: https://redteam.com/about.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page explains Active Project Value pricing, an annual-price calculator for smaller tiers and custom quotations for larger accounts. Source: https://redteam.com/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: RedTeam's homepage features customer testimonials attributed to T&G Constructors and ASI General Contractors. Source: https://redteam.com/. | named_customers.0: The homepage testimonial identifies Julio Claussen as Project Manager at T&G Constructors and links to its case study. | named_customers.1: The homepage testimonial identifies Joel Anzelc as Vice President of ASI General Contractors and describes using RedTeam.

employee_band.notes: LeadIQ reports approximately 99 employees as of August 2026, while the company profile reports 98; both fall in 51-100. These are third-party headcount estimates. Sources: https://leadiq.com/c/redteam---construction-technology/5a1da3502300005e009569a6 and https://linkedin.com/company/redteamsoftware.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: RedTeam's company history explicitly identifies its headquarters as Orlando, Florida. Source: https://redteam.com/about-us. | hq_country: The company profile lists United States, and RedTeam's own history identifies its headquarters as Orlando, Florida. Sources: https://linkedin.com/company/redteamsoftware and https://redteam.com/about-us.

founded_year.notes: RedTeam's about page states it has helped contractors since 2006, and its company profile explicitly lists 2006 as its founding year. Sources: https://redteam.com/about and https://linkedin.com/company/redteamsoftware.

eng_blog.notes: The reviewed indexes show construction advice, buyer guides, insurance, procurement and other customer-facing topics, rather than two engineer-authored posts explaining how RedTeam is built. Sources: https://redteam.com/resources/release-notes and https://blog.redteam.com/.

public_docs.notes: The public help center lists extensive documentation, including 133 Fieldlens articles, 501 RedTeam Go articles and 236 RedTeam Flex articles. Source: https://help.redteam.com/en.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official aggregate job board explicitly says no jobs are posted. Separately accessible AE and SDR applications are nonqualifying titles; their existence creates some uncertainty about board completeness, but no qualifying AI/ML title was found. Source: https://redteam.apscareerportal.com/jobs.

model_provider.value: Amazon Web Services (Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Textract)
model_provider.notes: RedTeam's implementation partner publicly identifies Amazon Bedrock and Textract in the document-processing solution. This establishes AWS services, not a particular underlying foundation model. Source: https://www.allata.com/client-stories/redteam-harnesses-aws-and-generative-ai-to-achieve-90-extraction-accuracy-and-supercharge-document-processing.

compliance_certs.notes: The readable privacy policy describes security safeguards but names none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR or PCI DSS. The empty list records the absence of those claims on the reviewed legal page, not proof that RedTeam lacks certifications. Source: https://redteam.com/privacy-policies.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding record classifies RedTeam Software's latest round as Series B. Source: https://tracxn.com. | funding_date: Both funding summaries identify February 2, 2022 as the latest round date, returned at the requested month precision. Sources: https://tracxn.com and https://leadiq.com/c/redteam---construction-technology/5a1da3502300005e009569a6. | funding_amount_usd: The funding record lists $28 million for the latest round, corroborated by LeadIQ's last-round summary. Sources: https://tracxn.com and https://leadiq.com/c/redteam---construction-technology/5a1da3502300005e009569a6.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified funding round is February 2022, well before the 18-month window. A dated legal-adviser announcement corroborates the 2022 investment by Braemont Capital and JettyCove. Sources: https://leadiq.com/c/redteam---construction-technology/5a1da3502300005e009569a6 and https://www.kirkland.com/news/press-release/2022/02/kirkland-advises-braemont-capital-and-jettycove.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The Account Executive–SMB posting is accessible with an application form. The aggregate board separately says no jobs are posted, so availability has a freshness caveat despite the live application. Source: https://redteam.careerplug.com/jobs/3327123/apps/new.

launched_6mo.notes: No qualifying launch was found in the six-month window. The substantive QuickBooks integration announcement located is dated March 18, 2026, before the window. The October release concerns configuration and labeling changes, while the November 9 report update explicitly says only the layout changed; those were excluded under the rule against UI tweaks. This conclusion is limited to the reviewed announcement history. Sources: https://redteam.com/insights-and-stories/redteam-go-quickbooks-integration-enhancements/, https://redteam.com/insights-and-stories/redteam-flex-release-notes-october-27-2026 and https://redteam.com/insights-and-stories/redteam-go-release-notes-november-9-2026/.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: RedTeam announced Jarrod Middleton's appointment as Chief Revenue Officer on April 1, 2026, within the requested 12-month window. Source: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/04/01/3266764/0/en/RedTeam-Appoints-Jarrod-Middleton-as-Chief-Revenue-Officer.html.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The AE and SDR postings explicitly require maintaining leads, opportunities or activity in HubSpot, establishing actual sales-stack usage rather than merely an integration. Sources: https://redteam.careerplug.com/jobs/3327123/apps/new and https://redteam.careerplug.com/jobs/3346961. | crm_stack_signal.0: The AE posting explicitly instructs the employee to manage leads, opportunities and account information within HubSpot.
